THE STAFFING CHALLENGE

Every gap in care, answered

Navigating the complex and demanding landscape of healthcare staffing can present numerous challenges, from the scarcity of qualified professionals to the need for specialized expertise in different healthcare settings. For each one, we've built a dedicated response.

01
Challenge 01

Healthcare shortage

The healthcare industry often faces a shortage of qualified professionals, which can put a strain on healthcare facilities and impact patient care.

InSync's response
  • A robust network of qualified healthcare professionals to promptly address staffing needs.
  • Extensive recruitment resources and strategies to attract top healthcare talent.
02
Challenge 02

High turnover rates

Healthcare professionals may experience burnout or seek better opportunities elsewhere, leading to high turnover rates and the need for constant recruitment.

InSync's response
  • Strong relationships, competitive compensation, and clear paths for professional growth and development.
  • A focus on satisfaction and work-life balance to reduce turnover and foster long-term partnerships.
03
Challenge 03

Specialized healthcare needs

Different healthcare facilities require professionals with specialized skills and expertise, such as critical care, pediatrics, or geriatrics.

InSync's response
  • Expertise in sourcing and placing professionals with specialized skills across healthcare settings.
  • Careful matching of facility requirements with the right professional expertise.
04
Challenge 04

Complex scheduling and shift coverage

Healthcare facilities must ensure adequate staffing for various shifts and maintain a balanced schedule to meet patient needs.

InSync's response
  • Advanced scheduling technology and a flexible staffing approach for comprehensive shift coverage.
  • Proactive management of conflicts, working closely with facilities to optimize efficiency.
PLACEMENT, HANDLED

The hard parts of placement

Placing the right healthcare professionals poses distinct challenges — seamless transitions between facilities, compliance with varying state regulations, and consistent quality of care. Here's what we manage on every assignment.

P01

Limited pool of available professionals

Demand for qualified healthcare professionals often exceeds supply, and location, specialty, and competition can further limit the available talent pool.

P02

Licensing & credentialing compliance

Each state has its own licensing and credentialing requirements. Verifying licenses, certifications, and documentation before placement can pose challenges.

P03

Adapting to different systems and policies

Professionals must quickly adapt to varied settings, policies, and electronic health record systems, and adjust to different workflows and patient populations.

P04

Managing onboarding and logistics

Coordinating onboarding, documentation, transportation, and on-site resources takes careful planning to keep every placement supported.

P05

Building rapport with existing staff

Joining teams on short notice makes quick rapport essential. Integration with clinicians, physicians, and support staff ensures continuity of care.

FULL-SPECTRUM SUPPORT

How we support our professionals

From recruitment and credentialing to onboarding, logistics, and team integration — nine ways we support every healthcare professional we place, end to end.

  1. 01

    Proactive recruitment and partnerships

    We maintain a robust network of healthcare professionals and partner with training programs and organizations to tap into emerging talent.

  2. 02

    Access to resources and support

    We provide training materials, documentation guidelines, and a support team to help professionals integrate into different healthcare settings.

  3. 03

    Clear communication channels

    We ensure access to key contacts within the facility, with regular check-ins and evaluations to keep communication open and address concerns promptly.

  4. 04

    National reach and extensive connections

    Our nationwide presence and industry connections let us access a wider pool of professionals and better match candidates to specific assignments.

  5. 05

    Relocation & housing support

    For roles that require relocation, we help professionals find suitable, affordable accommodations through our network and partnerships.

  6. 06

    Comprehensive orientation and onboarding

    Thorough orientation and onboarding on specific systems, policies, and procedures helps professionals adapt quickly and deliver high-quality care.

  7. 07

    Dedicated credentialing team

    A dedicated team stays current with state licensing requirements and keeps credentials verified and up-to-date, reducing administrative burden.

  8. 08

    Logistics coordination

    Our coordination team handles transportation and scheduling for smooth transitions into new assignments, so professionals can focus on their work.

  9. 09

    Team integration initiatives

    We organize activities and events that build relationships between our professionals and existing staff, encouraging collaboration and a positive environment.
